description: Add a durable, grounded learnings store to g2g: findings say what was broken, learnings say what we now know and why it must stay that way.

context.currentState: g2g accumulates FINDINGS (review-output/findings.json, stable F-IDs, dedup + stale/rejected lifecycle) but has no store for durable knowledge. The rationale behind hard-won invariants is therefore inlined into CLAUDE.md (F-059, F-060, F-061), where it is always-loaded, unindexed, unversioned against the code it describes, and grows without bound. A build produces a rich structured record — spec acceptanceCriteria, per-task notes with commit SHAs, the verifier verdict, and a deterministic evidence run — and that record is discarded once the PR merges.
context.targetState: A tracked docs/learnings/ store with stable L-IDs, a two-track frontmatter schema that makes entries retrievable, a deterministic grounding validator that refuses to let unverified claims enter the store, and a /g2g:compound command that turns a completed build (or an addressed finding) into exactly one grounded learning. CLAUDE.md keeps every prohibition and its one-line why, and cites L-IDs for the long-form incident record instead of carrying it inline.
constraints: Ships as installed plugin behavior: everything under plugin/ is subject to the version-bump rule. The bump is assigned to T-004 ONLY — builders on T-001, T-002 and T-003 must NOT bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json or add a CHANGELOG section.

/g2g:compound writes to the checkout, so it MUST join the checkout-lock protocol (acquire/refresh/release-terminal via g2g-lock.sh) exactly as build.md and go.md do. Never write unconditionally. See plugin/README.md 'Concurrency model'.

g2g-learning-check.sh is a deterministic script and must never call a model, never edit a file, and never auto-resolve a flag — it reports, a human or the command adjudicates. Same posture as g2g-evidence.sh and g2g-stop.sh.
Safety prohibitions stay always-loaded. The CLAUDE.md migration in T-004 removes NO prohibition and NO one-line rationale; only long-form incident detail moves out, replaced by an L-ID citation.
Shell is bash and must be shellcheck-clean against the repo .shellcheckrc. Tests are bats, one behavior per test, golden output where format is contractual.
Do not add a CONCEPTS.md or any third vocabulary store — CLAUDE.md and plugin/README.md already carry vocabulary, and a third store is the accretion problem this spec exists to fix.
Do not port session-history archaeology. g2g's spec + verifier record IS the source of truth; reconstructing history from transcripts is explicitly out of scope.

tasks.title: Add the writing-g2g-learnings skill (schema and rules contract)
tasks.description:
Create plugin/skills/writing-g2g-learnings/SKILL.md as the single contract for the learnings store, mirroring how plugin/skills/writing-g2g-specs/SKILL.md contracts the spec format. It is lazy-loaded, so detail here costs almost nothing resident — put the full schema in it rather than in CLAUDE.md.

It must define: (1) store layout docs/learnings/<category>/<slug>.md and the stable L-ID convention (L-001, L-002, ... allocated as highest-existing + 1, never reused, mirroring the existing F-ID convention in review-output/findings.json); (2) a two-track YAML frontmatter schema — a BUG track (a defect that was diagnosed and fixed) and a KNOWLEDGE track (a convention, architectural decision, or workflow rule that must survive turnover) — sharing required fields and differing in which extra fields are required; (3) the body section template; (4) capture preconditions; (5) the overlap rule; (6) the five-outcome maintenance model reserved for the follow-up refresh command.

Enum values must describe g2g's domain (commands, agents, scripts, hooks, templates, tests, evals, ci, config, docs), NOT a web framework's. Read plugin/skills/writing-g2g-specs/SKILL.md first and match its voice, length, and table style.

Do NOT bump the plugin version or touch CHANGELOG.md — T-004 owns the bump for this whole spec.

The skill documents required frontmatter fields shared by both tracks: id (L-NNN), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), track (bug|knowledge), area, severity, tags
The skill documents bug-track-only required fields (symptoms, rootCause, resolution) and states that the knowledge track requires none of them
Every enum the skill defines names g2g-domain values; the string 'rails' does not appear anywhere in the file (case-insensitive)

tasks.title: Add g2g-learning-check.sh, the deterministic grounding validator
tasks.description:
Create plugin/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh plus tests/plugin_learning_check.bats. This is the load-bearing piece: a learning that enters the store becomes trusted knowledge future agents act on WITHOUT re-verifying, so its claims are checked against the tree before they compound. Read plugin/scripts/g2g-evidence.sh first and follow its conventions — header line, per-item lines, a single summary line, frozen exit codes, no model call, no writes.

Usage: `g2g-learning-check.sh <path-to-learning.md>` validates one file; with no argument it validates every file under docs/learnings/.

Mechanical checks: (a) frontmatter parses as YAML and carries every required field for its declared track, with enum values and a YYYY-MM-DD date; (b) every repo-relative path cited in the body exists in the working tree; (c) every 7-to-40-character hex commit SHA cited in the body resolves, AND is reachable from the upstream default branch — a SHA reachable only from HEAD is reported as a DISTINCT flag from one that does not resolve at all, because a local-only SHA is one squash-merge away from unreachable and g2g's merge-never-squash rule exists for exactly that reason; (d) no drafting scaffold remains (a `{{` mustache, a bare `TODO`, or the literal pattern `Learning <digit>`); (e) every relative markdown link target resolves.

The script REPORTS flags and never resolves them: it must not edit any file, and a flagged run is not a failure of the learning, because learnings legitimately cite deleted paths and pre-fix states. Adjudication is the caller's job (T-003).

Do NOT bump the plugin version or touch CHANGELOG.md — T-004 owns the bump for this whole spec.
acceptanceCriteria: plugin/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh exists, is executable (mode 755), and starts with a bash shebang
`make lint` reports no shellcheck findings for the new script
Exit codes are exactly: 0 = all checks clean, 2 = a learning file is missing or its frontmatter is invalid, 3 = no learning files found to check, 4 = at least one flag raised requiring adjudication
tests/plugin_learning_check.bats exists and pins each of the four exit codes with a separate test
A test pins that a SHA reachable only from HEAD produces a different flag label than a SHA that resolves nowhere
A test pins that a cited repo-relative path which does not exist raises a flag
A test pins that drafting scaffold (`{{`, a bare TODO, or `Learning <digit>`) raises a flag
A test pins the exact header line and the exact summary line, golden-output style, matching how tests/plugin_evidence.bats pins g2g-evidence.sh's format
A test asserts the script leaves its input file byte-identical after a run that raises flags — the script never edits
The script contains no model or network invocation: `grep -Ei 'claude|curl|wget|http' plugin/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh` returns no functional call site

tasks.notes: Added plugin/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh to the Makefile lint file list — otherwise make lint silently skips the new script and that criterion passes vacuously. Only change outside the two new files. Reachability: resolves the upstream default branch via origin/HEAD symref, falling back to origin/main|origin/master; with no origin configured every resolvable SHA is conservatively reported head-only rather than passing silently. Path/link citation detection is scoped to backtick-quoted slash-bearing tokens and standard markdown links — a deliberate documented boundary avoiding false positives on enum values and command names. Frontmatter/body shape matches T-001 field-for-field, including the knowledge-track omit rule enforced as an invalid-frontmatter condition. Did not touch docs/learnings/ (T-004 seeds it). make check: 232 ok / 0 not ok.

tasks.title: Add the /g2g:compound command (capture)
tasks.description:
Create plugin/commands/compound.md, a numbered imperative procedure in the house style — read plugin/commands/go.md first for the shortest complete example of the lock protocol, and plugin/commands/review.md for how a command reads a tracked record.

Arguments: `/g2g:compound [<spec-path>|F-NNN]`. With a spec path, the source of truth is that spec — its acceptanceCriteria, per-task notes, cited commit SHAs, and the top-level verifier field. With an F-NNN, the source is that finding in review-output/findings.json plus the commits that addressed it. With no argument, resolve the most recently modified spec under specs/ carrying a non-null verifier field.

Phases: (1) acquire the checkout lock and refresh it, releasing via `g2g-lock.sh release-terminal <owner-token>` on EVERY terminal path including abort; (2) check preconditions — refuse when the work is not finished, and state that a spec with no verifier verdict is a refusal, not a warning; (3) read the source record, never the conversation, and never assert behavior from memory — read the defining source line before asserting it; (4) check overlap against existing learnings per the writing-g2g-learnings skill and update in place when overlap is high; (5) write EXACTLY ONE learning; (6) run `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh` on the written file and adjudicate every flag with one of exactly three resolutions — fix the claim, annotate it as historical, or confirm it intentional — never an automatic pass and never an automatic rewrite; re-run until clean or every remaining flag is confirmed; (7) report.

The command must never write CLAUDE.md, plugin/README.md, or any other instruction file — a command that edits the repo's operating contract as a side effect is out of scope here.

Do NOT bump the plugin version or touch CHANGELOG.md — T-004 owns the bump for this whole spec.
acceptanceCriteria: plugin/commands/compound.md exists with frontmatter `description` and `argument-hint` that match the behavior the body specifies
The procedure acquires the checkout lock before its first write and calls `g2g-lock.sh release-terminal <owner-token>` on every terminal path, abort paths included
The procedure states that a spec whose top-level verifier field is null or absent is a refusal to capture, not a warning

The procedure runs ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh against the file it wrote, and names all three adjudication resolutions (fix, annotate, confirm intentional) while forbidding an automatic pass
The procedure states that it re-runs the check script after any body edit until the run is clean or every remaining flag is explicitly confirmed intentional
The procedure writes exactly one learning file per invocation and says so explicitly
The procedure explicitly forbids writing CLAUDE.md, plugin/README.md, or any other instruction file
The procedure instructs reading the defining source line before asserting code behavior, and preferring a PR number over a commit SHA when citing merged work

tasks.title: Seed the store from F-059/F-060/F-061, document it, and bump the version
tasks.description:
THIS TASK OWNS THE VERSION BUMP FOR THE ENTIRE SPEC. T-001, T-002 and T-003 were told not to bump; do it here exactly once.

Four parts.

(1) Seed docs/learnings/ with three real learnings, L-001 from F-059 (evidence head-binding), L-002 from F-060 (the bats enforcement canary and macOS bash 3.2 swallowing mid-test asserts), L-003 from F-061 (post-verifier-PASS changes amend the spec record). Take the long-form incident detail from CLAUDE.md, review-output/findings.json, CHANGELOG.md, and the commits that addressed each finding. Every one must pass plugin/scripts/g2g-learning-check.sh cleanly or with every flag confirmed intentional.

(2) Migrate CLAUDE.md CONSERVATIVELY. Every prohibition and every one-line rationale STAYS — these are always-loaded safety rules and moving them into a lazily-loaded doc is the one thing this spec must not do. What moves is the long-form incident record only, and each affected bullet gains an L-ID citation next to its existing F-ID citation. Add one pointer line naming docs/learnings/ as the store and /g2g:compound as the way entries get written.

(3) Document the command in plugin/README.md, including an entry in its 'Concurrency model' section recording that /g2g:compound holds the lock (as opposed to the read-only status query used by spec.md, review.md, and dev.md Phase A).

(4) Bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json from 0.6.5 to 0.7.0 — a minor bump, since this adds a command, a skill, and a script rather than fixing behavior — and add the matching ## 0.7.0 section to CHANGELOG.md in the same commit, since scripts/tag-release.sh reads the notes as of the bump commit and fails on a bump whose notes arrive later.
